items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley exited early with hamstring injury (2 carries); most notable of several key PHI losses.
items.why: Hurt on run out of bounds Q1; downgraded to out.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 5 London; IR candidate if multi-week; hold.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is scheduled for an MRI on his ankle today after leaving Sunday's game in a walking boot and not returning after halftime; initial reports indicate day-to-day.
items.why: Sacked late first half, left stadium in boot; coach said dealing with ankle, contemplated return.
items.implication: Major Week 5 uncertainty vs ATL; hold but have backup ready; Ravens offense changes without him.
items.opportunity: If out, Huntley starts; more Henry volume possible.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase suffered a concussion vs Jaguars and was ruled out after early exit; enters protocol.
items.why: Facemask + hit to turf in Q2; did not return.
items.implication: Week 5 availability uncertain pending protocol clearance; monitor practice.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Bengals WRs if sits.

items.text: Bengals WR Tee Higgins left late with adductor injury after big game (11-157); extent unknown.
items.why: Adductor after catch late Q4; returned briefly then out.
items.implication: Could miss time; Bengals WR depth thin with Chase also hurt.
items.opportunity: If both out, other CIN receivers surge.

items.text: Broncos WR Pat Bryant sprained ankle Sunday, expected to miss a few weeks.
items.implication: DEN WR depth hit; monitor for return timeline.
items.opportunity: Other Broncos receivers or TEs gain snaps/targets.

items.text: Despite pregame hip/groin hysteria and limit speculation, Puka Nacua played 76-of-84 snaps, 49 routes on 64 dropbacks, 12 targets + goal-line carry in return.
items.why: Rams had no intention to limit per Schefter; confirmed high volume.
items.implication: Full every-week WR1 role restored; small prior dock removed.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target share confirmed; start confidently ROS.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice tweaked hamstring, downgraded doubtful, will use bye week to recover; not long-term expected.
items.why: Left early, did not return; bye helps recovery.
items.implication: Likely available post-bye; KC WR room thinned further by Thornton.
items.opportunity: Short-term boost to other KC pass-catchers; Tyreek rumors.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with foot aggravation (prior ribs); watched on injury list post-game.
items.why: Aggravation noted after expected play; prior LP-DNP-LP week.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 5; bigger dock possible if limited.
items.opportunity: If sits, other LAC WRs (Johnston etc) rise.

items.text: ETR post-Sunday watch: Lamar (ankle), Chase (conc)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (ham)/Bigsby, Rice (ham)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot), DJ Moore (shoulder), Pat Bryant (ankle), others.
items.why: Comprehensive post-game injury monitoring list for fantasy.
items.implication: Prioritize these for waivers/start-sit this week.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries emerge as statuses firm (e.g. handcuffs).

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore aggravated shoulder, not considered long-term issue currently.
items.why: Did not return in loss; source says not long-term.
items.opportunity: Without him, Coleman 30%+ target share in sample; Kincaid/Shakir/Cook bump.

items.text: Bills OC Joe Brady on Dalton Kincaid's 2 targets: 'I have to be better. No reason Kincaid should have two targets given game flow.' Sample without DJ Moore showed Kincaid 13% share.
items.why: Coach self-critique post low involvement; positive for involvement going forward.
items.implication: Potential target rebound if Moore limited; TE upside rises.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams: boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role uncertainty who is starting and crushing.
items.why: Emerging as reliable starter amid role clarity.
items.implication: Strong ROS hold/start; buy if available.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (maintenance/workload, not new injury); limited in crucial spots despite feeling able.
items.why: Coaches managing long season/body; Love honest about not 100% spectacular.
items.implication: Volatile weekly floor; committee risk continues.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns called back due to penalty.
items.why: Penalties wiped scores; shows goal-line/opportunity presence.
items.implication: Positive underlying usage signal despite box score; stash/watch.
items.opportunity: Red-zone role expanding in JAC backfield.
